summary: Milestone Scientific Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to compensation agreements with former Chairman and CEO Leonard Osser. The New Osser Agreement restructures employment and consulting arrangements, reducing employment compensation by $100,000 to $200,000 per year and increasing consulting compensation by the same amount, split equally between cash and shares. Past amounts owed include $64,080 in arrears and a $75,000 catch-up payment. This is a routine compensatory arrangement, not a special situation event. No deal terms or strategic corporate action are involved.
